description: Register a consistent on-camera person (avatar) for talking-head ad presets. Provide an image_url of a face, OR just a text description to have a reference portrait generated for you (that generation is billed like an image). Returns an avatar_id for studio_generate.

description.description: Who the avatar is, e.g. "young athletic woman, mid-20s, ponytail, casual gymwear"

image_url.description: Optional http(s)/data:image URL of the face; omit to generate a reference portrait from the description

name: studio_register_avatar
title: Register a creator avatar
